yellow_bohai.rule: Spherical nearest Gaussian center to each fixed OISST ocean center; sum original cosine-latitude ocean weights. No land-fraction correction; coarse coastal cells may include land.

northern_ecs.rule: Spherical nearest Gaussian center to each fixed OISST ocean center; sum original cosine-latitude ocean weights. No land-fraction correction; coarse coastal cells may include land.

scope: Retrospective exploratory design after all original Yellow–Bohai outcomes were viewed. Not a prospective or untouched holdout. Model hyperparameters selected using Yellow–Bohai 2020–2021 seven-day errors only; parameters refitted on 2010–2019 for each horizon. Destination-local references use those same source-selected hyperparameters. Direct transfer copies all source coefficients and scaling without destination fitting. Physical features use reanalysis no later than origin minus one day, a conservative temporal restriction, not a verified operational latency. Daily reanalysis heat fluxes and winds are diagnostic model products, not independent flux observations or proof of causality. Original frozen protocols and results are preserved.
